snippet.title: Planted! - Release Date Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Planted! is part harvest sim and part sports game: 1–4 players sow, grow and throw produce in arena battles. You can grow colossal crops with fertilizer, steal your rivals' veg, or use power-ups to win. From Cloth Cat Games and Curveball Games, coming to PS5, Xbox Series, Switch and PC.
